messages.subject: Executive candidate | Energy, industrial strategy and international growth
messages.body:
Dear Krishnan & Associates Team,

I am submitting my executive CV through the candidate route published by Krishnan & Associates. Your work across power, energy transition, grid modernization, industrial markets and international business development aligns closely with the environments where I have built my career.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ years of experience span multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, with current responsibility across ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

My recent work includes institutional and governance support around large-scale solar and battery-storage deployment, carbon-data readiness, regulatory coordination and strategic stakeholder engagement. I also bring direct experience working with ministries, regulators, contractors, communities and executive teams around complex operating and investment priorities.

I am targeting leadership and advisory mandates across energy, industrial strategy, market entry, government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and country or regional growth. I am open to international assignments and have a 30-day notice period.

Please find my focused executive CV attached for consideration against relevant current or upcoming mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
